privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires configuring 4 cameras: Entrance (25fps/4096kbps/High), Parking Lot & Lobby (15fps/2048kbps/Normal), and Server Room (10fps/1024kbps/Low). All must be 24/7. The report path is /home/ga/recording_policy_report.txt. The total bitrate for the storage calculation is 9216 kbps (4096 + 2048 + 2048 + 1024). The correct storage calculation is (9216 * 86400) / 8 / 1024 / 1024 = 94.921875 GB/day.
